mn32:16.17: so yāya vihārasamāpattiyā ākaṅkhati pubbaṇhasamayaṃ viharituṃ tāya vihārasamāpattiyā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ viharati
mn32:16.18: yāya vihārasamāpattiyā ākaṅkhati majjhantikasamayaṃ viharituṃ tāya vihārasamāpattiyā majjhantikasamayaṃ viharati
mn32:16.19: yāya vihārasamāpattiyā ākaṅkhati sāyaṇhasamayaṃ viharituṃ tāya vihārasamāpattiyā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ viharati
mn32:16.20: evarūpena kho āvuso moggallāna bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyāti.
mn32:16.23: sāriputto hi moggallāna cittaṃ vasaṃ vatteti no ca sāriputto cittassa vasena vattati
mn32:16.24: so yāya vihārasamāpattiyā ākaṅkhati pubbaṇhasamayaṃ viharituṃ tāya vihārasamāpattiyā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ viharati
mn32:16.25: yāya vihārasamāpattiyā ākaṅkhati majjhantikasamayaṃ viharituṃ tāya vihārasamāpattiyā majjhantikasamayaṃ viharati
mn32:16.26: yāya vihārasamāpattiyā ākaṅkhati sāyaṇhasamayaṃ viharituṃ tāya vihārasamāpattiyā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ viharatīti.
mn32:17.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn32:17.4: apica mama vacanaṃ suṇātha yathārūpena bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyāti
mn32:17.5: idha sāriputta bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā
mn32:17.6: na tāvāhaṃ imaṃ pallaṅkaṃ bhindissāmi yāva me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatīti
mn32:17.7: evarūpena kho sāriputta bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyāti.
mn32:17.9: attamanā te āyasmanto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
